title: GitLog
description: A simple web app to store and view notes from books I’ve read. Built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.

title: CV builder
description: A responsive web application built with React that allows users to create resumes through form. I built it to learn about fundamentals of react, including components, props, hooks and dynamic form handling

title: Hennest
description: Hennest is a financial management platform built with React, Clerk, and TailwindCSS that lets users connect bank accounts, set spending goals, and get real-time budget alerts with spending insights.

title: Birds of a Feather
description: Birds of a Feather is a solitaire puzzle game built in Java and JavaFX. Players arrange cards on a grid and merge stacks by matching suits or ranks (including adjacent ranks), aiming to combine all cards into one stack.
